strings.zh: 尊敬的客人,欢迎乘坐圣安努号游轮！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome aboard the S.S. Anne, honored{NEWLINE}guest!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: #0–#9: S.S. Anne ferry desk (Vermilion/Olivine); #10–#62: One Island, Alto Mare Islands.

strings.zh: 客人您有事吗？{NEWLINE}今天不出航！
strings.en: Can I help you? We’re not sailing today!

strings.zh: 您好,欢迎乘坐新圣安努号游轮。{NEWLINE}请问您想的目的地是？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello, and welcome aboard the new{NEWLINE}S.S. Anne. Where would you like to go?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 浅葱市
strings.en: Olivine City

strings.zh: 枯叶市
strings.en: Vermilion City

strings.zh: 我等会儿再来
strings.en: I’ll come back later

strings.zh: 真是抱歉,{NEWLINE}现在开往城都地区的航线还未恢复,{CLEAR}所以暂时去不了浅葱市。
strings.en: I’m very sorry.{SCROLL}Service to Johto hasn’t resumed yet,{NEWLINE}so we can’t sail to Olivine City for now.

strings.zh: 好的,目的地枯叶市,请您登船！
strings.en: Very well. Destination: Vermilion City.{NEWLINE}Please come aboard!

strings.zh: 好的,目的地浅葱市,请您登船！
strings.en: Very well. Destination: Olivine City.{NEWLINE}Please come aboard!

strings.zh: 不过现在是群岛的涨潮期,{NEWLINE}为了保证游客们的安全,{CLEAR}暂时只开放一、二、三岛供游客观光。{CLEAR}如果您想去其他四岛的话,{CLEAR}得等一段时间再来了。
strings.en: However, it’s high-tide season in the{NEWLINE}islands.{SCROLL}For our passengers’ safety, only One,{NEWLINE}Two and Three Island are open to{CLEAR}visitors for now.{SCROLL}If you’d like to visit the other four{NEWLINE}islands, please come back another time.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,又来到水都群岛了,{NEWLINE}先去海上男儿餐厅吃顿好的再说。
strings.en: Heh heh, back in the Alto Mare Islands{NEWLINE}again.{SCROLL}First, a good meal at the Seafarers’{NEWLINE}Restaurant!
strings.notes: 海上男儿餐厅 → ‘the Seafarers’ Restaurant’ (invented).

strings.zh: 这里是水都群岛——一之岛。
strings.en: This is One Island in the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands.

strings.zh: 草绳结的威力会根据{NEWLINE}对手体重不同而变化,{CLEAR}当对手体重在200kg以上时,{CLEAR}威力甚至可以达到惊人的120！
strings.en: Grass Knot’s power depends on the{NEWLINE}target’s weight.{SCROLL}Against a foe of 200 kg or more, it hits{NEWLINE}with a whopping 120 power!

strings.zh: 我的罗丝雷朵虽然力气不大,{NEWLINE}但却非常擅长在对战中借力打力,{CLEAR}你也想学习这方面的技巧吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: My Roserade isn’t very strong, but in{NEWLINE}battle it’s great at turning a foe’s own{CLEAR}weight against it.{SCROLL}Want to learn that kind of technique?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不想学吗……{NEWLINE}明明是很聪明的战斗方式。
strings.en: You don’t want to learn it...? It’s such{NEWLINE}a clever way to fight.

strings.zh: 哦？你要用种子换我的技巧啊？{SCROLL}没问题,你的种子我收下了,{NEWLINE}然后……这个给你。
strings.en: Oh? You want to trade a seed for my{NEWLINE}technique?{SCROLL}No problem. I’ll take your seed, and{NEWLINE}then... this is for you.

strings.zh: 这里面记录着罗丝雷朵{NEWLINE}借力打力的战斗技巧,{CLEAR}你要好好利用哦。
strings.en: This holds Roserade’s technique for{NEWLINE}turning a foe’s weight against it.{SCROLL}Make good use of it.

strings.zh: 我听说有个能提高{NEWLINE}草系招式威力的神奇种子,{CLEAR}如果你想学罗丝雷朵的战斗技巧,{CLEAR}就拿一颗这样的种子来跟我换吧。
strings.en: I’ve heard of an amazing seed that{NEWLINE}powers up Grass-type moves.{SCROLL}If you want Roserade’s technique,{NEWLINE}trade me one of those seeds.

strings.zh: 要用奇迹种跟对方交换吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Trade a Miracle Seed?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 传说中拉帝欧斯和拉帝亚斯{NEWLINE}是一之岛的守护神,{CLEAR}可是人们却只在绘本上见过它们。{SCROLL}如果我能跟这两只精灵中的{NEWLINE}其中一只合个影的话,{CLEAR}就算是不虚此行了。
strings.en: Legend says Latios and Latias are One{NEWLINE}Island’s guardian deities.{SCROLL}But people have only ever seen them in{NEWLINE}picture books.{SCROLL}If I could get a photo with either one{NEWLINE}of them, this trip would be worth it.

strings.zh: 欢迎来到水都群岛。
strings.en: Welcome to the Alto Mare Islands.

strings.zh: 从这里望去海阔风平、远影孤舟,{NEWLINE}确实是配得上「水都」之名的美景。
strings.en: From here you can see the wide, calm{NEWLINE}sea and a lone boat far away.{SCROLL}Truly a view worthy of Alto Mare’s name.

strings.zh: 你是第一次来水都群岛吗？
strings.en: Is this your first time in the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands?

strings.zh: 请您尽情享受{NEWLINE}在水都群岛的美好时光。
strings.en: Please enjoy your time in the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands.

strings.zh: 水都群岛共有7座主岛{NEWLINE}和2个大型岛礁组成,{CLEAR}目前一之岛、二之岛、三之岛{CLEAR}商业化开发程度较高,{CLEAR}绝对是您旅行购物的首选。{SCROLL}如果您想感受水都群岛的自然气息,{NEWLINE}四、五、六、七岛将会带给您{CLEAR}完全不同的感受。
strings.en: The Alto Mare Islands consist of 7 main{NEWLINE}islands and 2 large reefs. One, Two and{CLEAR}Three Island are the most developed.{CLEAR}They’re definitely the top choice for{CLEAR}shopping on your trip. If you want to{CLEAR}experience the islands’ natural side,{CLEAR}Four, Five, Six and Seven Island will{CLEAR}feel completely different.

strings.zh: 哇！你身旁的那只精灵{NEWLINE}不就是拉帝亚斯吗！？
strings.en: Wow! Isn’t that Pokémon next to you{NEWLINE}Latias?!

strings.zh: 哇！你身旁的那只精灵{NEWLINE}不就是拉帝欧斯吗！？
strings.en: Wow! Isn’t that Pokémon next to you{NEWLINE}Latios?!

strings.zh: 可以让我跟它合张影吗？拜托了。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Could I take a picture with it? Please!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不行吗？那真是太遗憾了……
strings.en: No? That’s too bad...

strings.zh: 太棒了！请你帮我们好好拍几张照片。
strings.en: Yay! Please take some nice photos of{NEWLINE}us.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『准备好,我要开始拍咯！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ready? Here I go!

strings.zh: 我看一下拍的怎么样……
strings.en: Let me see how they turned out...

strings.zh: 嗯！拍的非常好呢！{SCROLL}谢谢你能让我跟传说中的精灵合影,{NEWLINE}这是在海边专用的防晒镜,送给你吧！
strings.en: Wow! They came out great!{SCROLL}Thanks for letting me take a photo with{NEWLINE}a legendary Pokémon.{SCROLL}Here, have these beach sunglasses!
strings.notes: 防晒镜 (‘beach sunglasses’): which item the script gives isn't visible (Black Glasses? Wise Glasses?).

strings.zh: 你居然能收服传说中的精灵,{NEWLINE}真是太厉害了。
strings.en: You actually caught a legendary{NEWLINE}Pokémon? That’s amazing.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好,再换个姿势！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: OK, now another pose!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好了,可以了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: OK, that’s a wrap.

strings.zh: 在我们群岛餐厅{NEWLINE}既可以品尝到各地的美味小吃,{CLEAR}又能享受对战的乐趣,{CLEAR}请您务必进店体验一下。
strings.en: At our Island Restaurant, you can{NEWLINE}taste delicious snacks from all over and{CLEAR}enjoy battles, too! Please be sure to{CLEAR}stop by!
strings.notes: RV028: name: 群岛餐厅 = the Island Restaurant (D-0869); omission: 美味 restored

strings.zh: 三之岛的叔叔阿姨们搬走的时候,{NEWLINE}把这只露力丽送给了我。{CLEAR}它真的好可爱啊！
strings.en: When the folks on Three Island moved{NEWLINE}away, they gave me this Azurill.{SCROLL}It’s sooo cute!

strings.zh: 露力丽『Azu——riii！
strings.en: Azurill: Azu-riii!

strings.zh: 罗丝雷朵『Rooo——se！
strings.en: Roserade: Rooo-se!

strings.zh: 雨翅蛾的原栖息地是芳缘地区,{NEWLINE}在关东和城都是抓不到的。{SCROLL}但是因为水都群岛{NEWLINE}特殊的地理位置和气候,{CLEAR}很多芳缘和神奥地区的精灵{CLEAR}都会在这里出现哦。
strings.en: Masquerain are native to Hoenn. You{NEWLINE}can’t catch them in Kanto or Johto.{SCROLL}But thanks to the Alto Mare Islands’{NEWLINE}special location and climate, lots of{CLEAR}Hoenn and Sinnoh Pokémon show up here.

strings.zh: 根据我对传说的研究,{NEWLINE}拉帝欧斯和拉帝亚斯能赶走邪恶强盗,{CLEAR}不仅仅是因为他们自身的强大。{CLEAR}还因为他们拥有着{CLEAR}一个特殊的力量增幅道具「心之水滴」。{SCROLL}如果水都群岛的传说{NEWLINE}是真实发生过的事情,{CLEAR}那么心之水滴一定藏在群岛某处！
strings.en: From my research into the legends,{NEWLINE}Latios and Latias didn’t drive off evil{CLEAR}thieves just because they’re strong.{SCROLL}They also had a special item that boosts{NEWLINE}their power: the Soul Dew.{SCROLL}If the Alto Mare legend really{NEWLINE}happened, then the Soul Dew must be{CLEAR}hidden somewhere in the islands!

strings.zh: 你相信传说中守护水都群岛的{NEWLINE}拉帝欧斯和拉帝亚斯是真实存在的吗？
strings.en: Do you believe Latios and Latias, the{NEWLINE}legendary guardians of the Alto Mare{CLEAR}Islands, really exist?

strings.zh: 不管你怎么想,{NEWLINE}我觉得那些传说中的精灵{CLEAR}都是真实存在的。
strings.en: Whatever you think, I believe all those{NEWLINE}legendary Pokémon are real.

strings.zh: 对吧对吧！{NEWLINE}就比如说我小时候有一次{CLEAR}失足掉进了湍急的河道里,{CLEAR}正当我在水中挣扎的时候,{CLEAR}我就感觉自己被什么给抱上了岸。{CLEAR}可是当我起身环顾四周时,{CLEAR}却什么也没有发现。{SCROLL}但我知道那一定是{NEWLINE}拉帝欧斯和拉帝亚斯在暗中保护了我！
strings.en: Right, right?! Like when I was little, I{NEWLINE}slipped and fell into a raging stream.{SCROLL}As I struggled in the water, I felt{NEWLINE}something lift me onto the bank.{SCROLL}But when I got up and looked around,{NEWLINE}there was nothing there.{SCROLL}But I know it must have been Latios and{NEWLINE}Latias, secretly protecting me!

strings.zh: 雨翅蛾『Masss——que！
strings.en: Masquerain: Masss-que!

strings.zh: 水都图书馆
strings.en: Alto Mare Library
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s) Old TM said ‘Route 204’; zh is 水都图书馆 (as 0272 #19).

strings.zh: 水都群岛旅行社,{NEWLINE}带您游遍美丽的水乡！
strings.en: Alto Mare Islands Travel Agency{NEWLINE}Tours of our beautiful water town!

strings.zh: 前方似乎已经没有路了。
strings.en: There doesn’t seem to be a path ahead.

strings.zh: 您好,我是精灵联盟的纪检委员,{NEWLINE}我们刚刚收到群众提供的证据,{CLEAR}证明您与三之岛的黑恶势力勾结,{CLEAR}收受他们的金钱充当他们的保护伞。{SCROLL}对此达马兰奇主席非常重视,{NEWLINE}他老人家希望您能洁身自好,{CLEAR}保持身为联盟冠军的尊严,{CLEAR}千万不要走罪犯坂木的老路。{SCROLL}为了给公众一个交代,{NEWLINE}我们将按照您的财力{CLEAR}最高扣除您收受金额的双倍作为惩戒,{CLEAR}请您积极配合。
strings.en: Hello. I’m a discipline inspector from{NEWLINE}the Pokémon League.{SCROLL}We have just received evidence from the{NEWLINE}public that you have been colluding with{CLEAR}organized crime on Three Island, taking{CLEAR}their money and acting as their{CLEAR}protective umbrella.{SCROLL}President Goodshow takes this very{NEWLINE}seriously.{SCROLL}He hopes you will keep your hands clean,{NEWLINE}uphold the dignity of the League{CLEAR}Champion and never follow in the{CLEAR}footsteps of the criminal Giovanni.{SCROLL}To give the public an answer, we will{NEWLINE}deduct up to double the amount you{CLEAR}received as a penalty, as far as your{CLEAR}finances allow.{SCROLL}We ask for your full cooperation.
strings.notes: Anti-corruption satire (纪检委员 discipline inspector, 黑恶势力 organized crime, 保护伞 ‘protective umbrella’, 不负初心 slogan in #53) kept faithful. Triggered by taking the Three Island gang's money (cf. D-0303 area banks).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}交纳了罚金！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} paid the fine!

strings.zh: 希望您能以此为戒,{NEWLINE}不负人生最初的那一颗真心。
strings.en: May this be a lesson to you. Stay true{NEWLINE}to the pure heart you started out with.

strings.zh: 喵喵『唉,喵……
strings.en: Meowth: Sigh, meow...

strings.zh: 乘龙『Laaaa——pras！
strings.en: Lapras: Laaaa-pras!

strings.zh: 游客你好,现在是水都群岛的涨潮期,{NEWLINE}为了您的安全公共海域暂不开放。
strings.en: Hello, visitor. It’s high-tide season in{NEWLINE}the Alto Mare Islands.{SCROLL}The public waters are closed for your{NEWLINE}safety.

strings.zh: 前面的树好像只是一个幻影！
strings.en: The tree ahead seems to be just an{NEWLINE}illusion!

strings.zh: 卡侬『……{SCROLL}少女睁着大眼睛看了看你。
strings.en: Bianca: ...{SCROLL}The girl gazes at you with wide eyes.
strings.notes: 卡侬 = Bianca (Pokémon Heroes); the girl in #58–#62 is presumably Latias in disguise.

strings.zh: 少女冲你眨了眨眼,{NEWLINE}似乎是想约你一起玩。
strings.en: The girl winks at you. She seems to want{NEWLINE}you to come play.

strings.zh: 少女在向你招手,似乎想要你过去。
strings.en: The girl is beckoning to you. She seems{NEWLINE}to want you to come over.

strings.zh: 少女钻入树丛不见了！
strings.en: The girl slipped into the bushes and{NEWLINE}vanished!

strings.zh: 少女正在拨弄着喷泉中的清水。
strings.en: The girl is playing with the clear water{NEWLINE}in the fountain.
